bio.text: David Russ is the Republican candidate for Oregon's 6th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the May 19, 2026 Republican primary.

Ballotpedia reports he was born in California, earned a bachelor's degree from Eastern Washington University in 1986, and has worked as an accountant, consultant, real estate broker and mayor, as well as in manufacturing and technology administration.
In his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey response, he says he was elected mayor of Dundee five times.
